correctness.rationale: For every finite commutative chain ring R of residue cardinality q and nilpotency length k, the proof constructs a generating additive character from the socle and uses exact ideal orthogonality. For a=nu(u), b=nu(v), the unnormalized Fourier multiplier of 1_{xy=0} follows by summing valuation shells; counting each shell gives all multiplicities, q=2 extra null antidiagonal and the only negative level -q^(k-1). The resulting rank is q^k(1+k(q-1)) for q>2, and for q=2 subtract (k-1)2^(k-2) when k>=2. An independent exact cyclotomic/discrete Fourier enumeration for Z/4,Z/8,Z/9 verified ranks 11,28,45 and negative counts 4,12,24. Those examples supplement, not replace, the all-ring shell proof.

value.rationale: The zero-product locus xy=0 is a natural singular algebraic relation; the entire additive-convolution spectrum, inertia, multiplicities and rank give useful exact harmonic-analysis invariants. The universal dependence only on (q,k), including an exceptional q=2 cancellation across rings of different characteristic, is structural rather than a routine one-dimensional Ramanujan sum table. Its exact classification could be used as benchmark for chain-ring convolution and related Cayley operators.
